guidelines.title: Community rules
guidelines.intro: Living Dose Community na place wey we dey support each other. These rules dey keep am safe and kind for everybody.

items.b: Everybody dey their own journey. Encourage, no judge. No bullying, hate or harassment.

items.t: Share wetin happen to you, no write prescription
items.b: Talk about wetin work for you, but no tell people make dem start, stop or change medicine. Na only health workers wey we don confirm dey give clinical advice here, and even that one na general advice: your own doctor sabi you pass.
No post phone numbers, address, email address or another person personal details. Use post-without-name for Mind and wellbeing.
No advert, product promotion, "miracle cure" or link to buy things.
If e be like say person dey danger, report the post so our team fit help. If na you dey crisis, call 112 or go the nearest hospital.
Our moderators dey check reports and dem fit remove posts or block accounts wey break these rules.

metaDescription: Community wey dem dey watch, wey dey support healthy living. Share your wins, ask questions and join weekly challenges.
